correctness.rationale: Face membership is equivalent to the support of the two-subsets omitting >=2 ground labels. Signed augmented Lefschetz trace of invariant two-subset-orbit selections reduces to a Boolean Möbius inversion over ground-label cycles, yielding sign(g)(f^2-3f+1) after concentration in degree n-4 from the Nilakantan–Singh wedge theorem. The character of wedge^2 U_n plus Specht(n-2,2), computed from ordinary and two-subset permutation modules, equals f^2-3f+1 on every cycle type, so semisimplicity gives the rational module identification. Independent orbit-mask recurrence verified all 38 cycle-type pairs for n=4..7 (and no extrapolation). The n=4 reduced H0 case is included.
